sample.summary: Changes to src/acc/diffs.py refactoring clipped_diff to share budget fairly across files are tested in tests/test_runner.py with test_truncation_keeps_every_file_visible verifying that small files remain visible when truncation occurs.

This commit fixes behavior in gate.py and runner.py where secret hits at warn level were masking check findings by introducing a new `secret_blocked` flag, with test coverage added (test_redacted_secret_does_not_mask_check_block).

This commit changes gitcmd.py to properly handle heredoc bodies and quoted emails by adding new parsing logic (_strip_heredocs function), with test coverage added for these scenarios (test_heredoc_body_is_data, test_email_in_quoted_message_is_not_a_redirect, test_heredoc_fed_to_shell_is_parsed).

Changes to src/acc/backends/claude.py (MAX_TURNS 2→4), src/acc/backends/fake.py (retryable error support), and src/acc/runner.py (retry logic) are tested with test_retryable_error_retried_even_for_single_entry_batch and argv flags test.

This commit changes only one line in cli.py, replacing `resolve()` with `absolute()` in a path handling function with a clarifying comment, which is a refactor that doesn't change behavior (both produce an absolute path).

Changes to src/acc/backends/claude.py adding MAX_THINKING_TOKENS environment override are tested in tests/test_claude_backend.py with test_thinking_forced_off_even_if_agent_env_enables_it covering the new ENV_OVERRIDES behavior.
Changes to src/acc/backends/claude.py adding SETTINGS constant and ENV_OVERRIDES for disabling thinking are tested in tests/test_claude_backend.py with a test for argv flags and thinking forced off.
New file src/acc/mcp_server.py with MCP server implementation is accompanied by comprehensive tests in tests/test_mcp.py covering list, get, run, test, add, update, promote, and grade operations.

This commit adds new Python modules (cli.py, gate.py, log.py) under src/acc/ and includes comprehensive test coverage with new test files (test_cli.py, test_gate.py) that directly test the behavior changes.

New files src/acc/grading.py and src/acc/ops.py with grading and operations logic are accompanied by comprehensive tests in tests/test_grading.py covering filtering, sampling, scoring, and grading behavior.

This commit adds new backend modules (backends/__init__.py, claude.py, fake.py), runner, prompt, and diffs modules along with corresponding test files (test_claude_backend.py, test_runner.py) that provide test coverage for the behavior changes.

New file src/acc/pushrange.py with 203 lines of behavior is accompanied by comprehensive tests in tests/test_pushrange.py with 159 lines covering push range resolution, various refspecs, and edge cases.

This commit adds git helper and git push command parser modules (git.py, gitcmd.py) with a comprehensive test file (test_gitcmd.py) containing 15+ test cases covering various push command parsing scenarios.
New file src/acc/secrets.py implementing secret scanning is accompanied by tests in tests/test_secrets_globs.py covering diff scanning, redaction, and glob matching functionality.

This commit adds check file format, config loading, and glob matching modules (checks.py, config.py, globs.py) along with comprehensive tests (test_checks.py) that cover the parsing, validation, and verdict mapping behavior.
This commit adds project scaffolding (.gitignore, README.md, pyproject.toml, __init__.py) and documentation, with no behavioral code changes that require tests.
